noProject.body: A project gets its own key and its own data. Create one for each site or app you want to measure, then paste the snippet.
noProject.bodyMember: This workspace has no Analytics projects yet. Ask an admin to create one.

web.error: We couldn't load web analytics. Try again.
web.noData: No pageviews yet. Paste the snippet on your site and visits show up here within seconds.
web.chartSummary: {visitors} visitors and {pageviews} pageviews in the period

events.title: Activity
events.description: Events as they arrive. New ones show up at the top every few seconds.
events.error: We couldn't load new events. Retrying.
events.empty: No events yet. Install the snippet or send one from your server and it shows up here.

result.noData: No data for this query in the selected period.
result.dropped: {count, plural, one {# person dropped off} other {# people dropped off}}
result.truncated: The query read the maximum number of rows (200,000). Narrow the date range for an exact result.
result.sqlRows: {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} in {ms} ms

editor.pathsNote: Paths follow pageviews within each session. They show the most common next page at each step.
editor.name: Name
editor.runHint: Run the query to see results.

errors.request_failed: The query didn't run. Try again.
errors.invalid_query: Something in the definition isn't valid. Check the events and filters.
errors.rate_limited: Too many queries in a minute. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have access to Analytics in this workspace.
errors.too_long: The query is too long (10,000 characters max).
errors.quoted_identifiers_not_allowed: Quoted identifiers aren't allowed. Use plain names.
errors.must_start_with_select: Queries start with SELECT or WITH.
errors.keyword_not_allowed: That keyword isn't allowed: queries are read-only
errors.table_not_allowed: Only the tables events, persons, person_distinct_ids and sessions are available
errors.unterminated_string: A string is missing its closing quote.
errors.invalid_character: The query has a character that isn't allowed
errors.sql_timeout: The query took too long (8 seconds max) and was stopped. Add filters or a shorter time range.
errors.join_without_condition: Each JOIN needs ON or USING, and FROM can’t list tables with commas.
errors.too_many_tables: A query reads at most two tables (counting each use of a WITH), and two only through one JOIN by key.
errors.join_not_allowed: Joins only go between two tables by their key: events.person_id = persons.id, events.distinct_id = person_distinct_ids.distinct_id, events.session_id = sessions.id, person_distinct_ids.person_id = persons.id or sessions.distinct_id = person_distinct_ids.distinct_id. Extra conditions go with AND.
errors.sql_busy: Too many SQL queries are running right now. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.invalid_formula: The formula is not valid. Use the series letters, numbers and + - * / ( ).
errors.math_property_required: Choose the numeric property to calculate.
errors.group_type_required: Write the group type to count.

editor.excludeInternal: Filter out internal and test people
editor.excludeInternalOff: This project has no rules for internal people yet.
editor.formulaHelp: Combine the series by letter: A / B * 100. The chart shows the result alone.
editor.formulaOff: Formulas do not work with a breakdown: remove it to use one.
editor.collapseIds: Group URLs that differ only by an id (/orders/123 as /orders/:id)
editor.stickyHelp: How many people did the event on exactly 1, 2, 3 or more of the days in the range.
editor.lifeHelp: Each period, who is new, who came back from the period before, who returned after a gap and who stopped.
editor.shareAdminsOnly: Only admins can make something public
editor.pathsNoteAll: Paths follow pages and your own events within each session. They show the most common next step.
editor.shareNoSql: SQL results can contain anything in the project, so they cannot be made public
editor.shareNoPersonBreakdown: A breakdown by person shows emails or ids, so it cannot be made public

sql.title: SQL
sql.description: Read-only SQL over this project's events, people and sessions (SQLite syntax).
sql.help: Tables: events (last 90 days, the newest 100,000), persons, person_distinct_ids, sessions. Read properties with json_extract(properties, '$.plan'). Timestamps are milliseconds. At most two tables, joined by key with ON. Up to 1,000 rows and 8 seconds. Run with ⌘ Enter.

insights.title: Insights
insights.description: Saved trends, funnels, retention, paths and SQL queries for this project.
insights.emptyBody: Build a trend, a funnel or a retention table and save it to find it here and add it to dashboards.
insights.name: Name
insights.deleteBody: The insight is deleted and leaves every dashboard it's on. The events stay.

dashboards.title: Dashboards
dashboards.description: Groups of saved insights you check together.
dashboards.emptyBody: Create a dashboard and add saved insights to it.
dashboards.name: Name
dashboards.deleteBody: The dashboard is deleted. Its insights stay in the list.
dashboards.tileEmptyBody: Add saved insights with the menu at the top.
dashboards.tileEmptyBodyNoInsights: Save an insight first, then add it here.
dashboards.shareAdminsOnly: Only admins can make something public

persons.title: People
persons.description: Everyone who sent events, with their properties and timeline.
persons.dropped: {count, plural, one {# person who dropped off the funnel} other {# people who dropped off the funnel}}.
persons.search: Search by distinct ID, email or property
persons.error: We couldn't load people. Try again.
persons.emptyBody: People show up when their first event arrives. Call identify() to link them to your user IDs.
persons.deleteBody: The person, their distinct IDs, sessions and every event they sent are erased. This can't be undone. Events they send later create a new person.

cohorts.title: Cohorts
cohorts.description: Groups of people by their properties or by what they did. Use them to filter insights.
cohorts.emptyBody: Create a cohort, such as people who viewed the pricing page three times this month.
cohorts.name: Name
cohorts.deleteBody: Insights filtered by this cohort stop working until you pick another one. People and events stay.
cohorts.typeStaticLabel: Static list (I will upload the people)
cohorts.metaGroups: {count, plural, one {# rule group} other {# rule groups}}
cohorts.groupsHelp: A person belongs if they match any group. Inside a group, they must match everything.
cohorts.staticHelp: Upload a CSV or paste a list with one per line: distinct id, person id or email in the first column. People who are not in the project are skipped and counted.
cohorts.pasteList: Paste ids or emails, one per line

flags.title: Feature flags
flags.description: Turn features on for some people, a percentage of them or by variant.
flags.keyHelp: Letters, numbers, - and _. Your code uses this key.
flags.emptyBody: Create a flag to release a feature gradually or to a group of people.
flags.name: Name
flags.deleteBody: Code that checks this flag gets no value (undefined) from now on.
flags.conditionsHelp: Only people whose properties match every condition. Without conditions, everyone is eligible.

errors.duplicate_key: Another flag already uses that key.
errors.variants_must_sum_100: Variants have to add up to 100%.
errors.invalid_input: Check the key: letters, numbers, - and _ only.
errors.flag_in_use: An experiment uses this flag. Delete the experiment first.
errors.flag_in_experiment: An experiment uses this flag. Only admins can turn it on or change its rollout.

flags.groupsHelp: Release groups are checked in order: the first one that matches and includes the person decides.
flags.payloadsHelp: Data that comes with each value. Read it with zs.getFeatureFlagPayload(key).
flags.payloadInvalid: The payload of {key} is not valid JSON.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Each project has its own key and its own data. Use one per site or app.
projects.descriptionMember: Projects of this workspace. Admins create and delete them.
projects.emptyBody: Create a project to get a key and start sending events.
projects.name: Name
projects.deleteBody: The key stops accepting events right away and all of the project's data is erased. This can't be undone.

settings.title: Install and settings
settings.installDesc: Paste this before </head>. It captures pageviews, and clicks, field changes and form submits if autocapture is on.
settings.publicKey: Public project key (safe to put in your site)
settings.apiHelp: API: zs.capture(event, properties), zs.identify(id, properties), zs.alias(id), zs.group(type, key, properties), zs.register(properties), zs.reset(), zs.isFeatureEnabled(key), zs.getFeatureFlag(key), zs.onFeatureFlags(callback). Add the class zs-no-capture to an element to skip it.
settings.serverDesc: The same endpoint takes batches of up to 200 events with the secret key. The secret key skips the allowed-domains check: never put it in a browser.
settings.secretOnce: Copy the secret key now. It won't be shown again.
settings.settingsDesc: What the snippet captures and how long data is kept.
settings.adminsOnly: Only admins can change these settings.
settings.name: Project name
settings.autocapture: Autocapture clicks, field changes and form submits
settings.autocaptureHelp: Field values are never captured. Text that looks like an email or a long number is dropped.
settings.respectDnt: Respect Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control
settings.anonymizeIp: Anonymize IP addresses (keep only the network part)
settings.domainsHelp: One per line, such as example.com or *.example.com. With a list, the public key only works from those sites. Empty means any site.
settings.timezoneHelp: Days and weeks in insights start at midnight in this zone and follow its daylight saving changes. Changing it rebuilds the daily totals.
settings.deleteDesc: The key stops accepting events right away. Events, people, insights, dashboards, cohorts and flags of the project are erased.
settings.internalDesc: Rules for who to leave out. Each insight can turn this on with its own checkbox.
settings.internalExample: Example: person property email, does not contain, @mycompany.com.
settings.guidesDesc: Reverse proxy, server SDKs and flags evaluated on your own server.
settings.proxyDesc: Serve the snippet and its requests from your own domain, so that blockers treat them as yours. Behind a proxy, the visitor's country is not detected: events get the proxy's country.
settings.proxyUse: Then point the snippet at it
settings.sdkDesc: The capture and flags endpoints speak the PostHog protocol: use posthog-node with your public key and this host. Other PostHog SDKs may work the same way; only posthog-node has been tried.
settings.localEvalDesc: Fetch the definitions with the secret key and evaluate them without a request per check. They use the same hash as PostHog.
settings.botsFiltered: {count, plural, =0 {No bot hits filtered so far.} one {# bot hit filtered so far.} other {# bot hits filtered so far.}} Known crawlers are left out by default.
settings.cookielessHelp: The snippet can run without storing anything in the browser, with cookieless_mode. Visitors are counted with a hash that changes every day, so the same person on two days counts twice and there are no person profiles. The IP is not stored. Off by default.
settings.cookielessDesc: Nothing is stored in the browser and identify does nothing. Recordings and surveys stay off in this mode. Turn on "Allow tracking without cookies" above first.

share.title: Public link
share.warning: Anyone with the link can see these results, including breakdown values and page paths, without signing in. The query definition and person ids stay private. Revoke a link to close it at once.
share.rateLimited: Too many visits right now. Try again in a minute.
share.tileError: This result could not be loaded.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Get a notice in the app when a trends insight crosses a threshold. Create them from the insight.
alerts.emptyBody: Open a saved trends insight and add an alert below the chart.
alerts.name: Alert
alerts.deleteBody: It stops checking and notifying. The insight stays.
alerts.help: Checked every hour or day on the last closed period. It notifies you in the app when it starts firing, once until it clears.
alerts.tooMany: This project reached 50 alerts. Delete one to add another.

correlation.title: What drives conversion
correlation.help: Compares people who finished the funnel with people who dropped. A correlation shows what goes together, not what causes what.
correlation.nothing: No signals with at least 2 people.
correlation.truncated: Based on a sample: the data was too large to read whole.
correlation.compared: Compared {converted} who converted with {dropped} who dropped.

experiments.title: Experiments
experiments.description: A/B tests on a feature flag, with exposure tracking and a probability for each variant.
experiments.emptyBody: Create one and it gets its own control and test flag, off until you start it.
experiments.name: Name
experiments.deleteBody: The results go with it. The flag and the events stay.
experiments.stopped: Stopped. Results stay frozen at this moment.
experiments.flagHelp: Your site reads it with zs.getFeatureFlag(key); that call records who saw which variant.
experiments.resultsDraft: Results appear once the experiment starts.
experiments.noExposures: Nobody has seen a variant yet. Read the flag {key} on your site with zs.getFeatureFlag.
experiments.multiple: {count} saw more than one variant and are left out
experiments.mismatch: The split between variants is far from what the flag sets. Check how the flag is read before trusting these results.
experiments.truncated: Based on a sample: the data was too large to read whole.
experiments.shipBody: The flag {flag} changes to this variant at 100%, without conditions.

errors.invalid_state: That is not possible in the current status.
errors.flag_not_multivariate: The flag needs at least two variants.
errors.invalid_variant: That variant is not in the flag.

experiments.adminsOnly: Only admins can start, stop, ship or delete an experiment

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: A name for one or more events, such as "Signed up" for a button click or a form. Use it in any insight with @name.
actions.emptyBody: Group events under a name that the whole team understands.
actions.name: Name
actions.deleteBody: Insights that use it stop counting it.
actions.stepsHelp: Any of these steps counts as the action.
actions.useHint: Use it in a new insight

annotations.title: Annotations
annotations.description: Mark launches and incidents. They show as marks on trends charts.
annotations.emptyBody: Add the first one with the form above.

data.title: Data management
data.description: The events of this project: describe them, mark the ones you trust and hide the ones that are noise from the selectors.
data.emptyBody: Install the snippet and events will show up here.
data.exportAdminsOnly: Only admins can export all events

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Companies, teams or accounts that arrive with zs.group(). Count by them in trends and funnels.
groups.emptyBody: Call zs.group('company', 'acme') on your site and they appear here.
